video_title: Is a deal coming soon for Karl-Anthony Towns? 🤔 + Latest on Jalen Duren & the Pistons | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns and the Knicks are far apart on contract extension
quotes.excerpt: the two sides are tens of millions of dollars apart on where they want to be

text_blocks.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
text_blocks.text: Vince, you were there in that press conference yesterday. What is the most important thing to know about where these talks stand between Karl-Anthony Towns and the Knicks?

text_blocks.speaker: Vince Carter
text_blocks.text: My arms can't go wide enough to say how far these two sides are right now. It's important to say he's not looking for $276 million on an extension. He of course wants to be rewarded for the sacrifices that he's made, but the two sides are tens of millions of dollars apart on where they want to be right now. And it doesn't seem to be much wiggle room. Don't forget, Josh Hart is eligible for an extension, Duane McBride wants a contract extension. When you're a champion, this is the last thing that you want coming into the season.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks core players must take pay cuts to avoid second apron
quotes.excerpt: unless these guys are willing to take pay cuts, the five of them are not going to stay

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: I'm going to say two things Knicks fans need to know that are simple but important. Number one, all five Knicks top-five players are back to play this season. They lost Mitchell Robinson, but their core five are back. That's great. They got the whole team back, they can compete again. The second thing is, unless these guys are willing to take pay cuts, Josh Hart, Karl-Anthony Towns, the five of them are not going to stay together.

text_blocks.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
text_blocks.text: And Karl-Anthony Towns, from what I have been told, is willing, similarly to what Jalen Brunson did, to take a pay cut. But the pay cut that the Knicks are asking him to take, he views as unreasonable.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Contract standoff between Jalen Duren and Pistons continues
quotes.excerpt: there is clearly a disconnect in the relationship business here

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: That ain't the greatest sign when your president of basketball operations is offering you $200 million and he can't get you on the phone or he doesn't want to get you on the phone. There is clearly a disconnect in the relationship business here. If it's extended beyond October 1st, that means both sides will continue negotiating. That means at least there's a signal that this could not be operating in good faith. Right now it doesn't seem like either side has a lot of faith in each other.

text_blocks.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
text_blocks.text: Does it make sense financially to do the qualifying offer ahead of becoming a restricted free agent because that's less than the 200 million that's on the table?

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Maybe, because if he knows 100% he's getting a max contract next year, he can make up the money he'd leave on the table.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Davis waiting until season end to discuss contract
quotes.excerpt: we're going to go through the season and try to do what I do at a high level
quotes.quote: I want to see the season is over. We're going to go through the season and try to do what I do at a high level. And then, you know, when it's over, sit down and have those conversations again with front office.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jokic confirms intent to re-sign with Nuggets
quotes.excerpt: I'm going to sign next year if they want me
quotes.quote: I'm going to sign next year if they want me.
